title: Shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the policy, repo-overlay and work-order schemas. Not a schema for any one file.

mode.description: What an agent may do with a protected path. Tightening order: allow < ask < deny.

pathModes.description: The mode per session kind (spec §8.2): interactive = the operator is in the session; unattended = Hermes cron, webhook and API surfaces; workers = Pi or Claude Code inside Archon.

tier.description: An abstract model tier. Rosters map tiers to models; work orders and roles name tiers, never model ids.

sourceTier.description: A trusted-source tier (spec §10): T0 pinned local snapshots, T1 first-party domains and package registries, T2 curated aggregators, T3 the open web.

effort.description: Reasoning effort, using Archon's ladder; Archon clamps it to what each provider supports.

hostname.description: A plain, lowercase domain name with at least two labels: no scheme, port, path, wildcard or leading dot, and not an IP address. The egress generator allows the domain and its subdomains.

repoPath.description: A path or glob relative to the repo root: not absolute, no '..' segment, no backslash or control characters.

pathGlob.description: A protected-path glob, anchored at the repo root: segments joined by single slashes; '**' as a whole segment matches zero or more segments, '*' any run of characters within one segment, '?' exactly one; every other character is literal. No '.', '..' or empty segment, no leading or trailing slash, and no '[', ']', '{', '}', '!', backslash or control character. A file's mode is the strictest across every glob that matches it (src/policy/paths.ts).

slug.description: Lowercase words joined by single hyphens, e.g. factory-task.

usd.description: An amount in US dollars, greater than zero.
